sources.title: James Gorman biography
sources.findings: Joined February 2006; co-president December 2007; CEO January 2010–December 2023; chair January 2012–December 2023; executive chair 2024; emeritus January 2025. Australia-born, Melbourne BA/law and Columbia MBA.
sources.caution: Current emeritus title differs from executive chair and CEO; no graduation dates inferred.

sources.title: James P. Gorman leadership biography
sources.findings: Director since 2024; board chair effective January 2, 2025.
sources.caution: Chair, not Disney CEO; effective date differs from October 2024 announcement.

sources.title: 2025 proxy statement
sources.findings: Pages 60 and 85: executive chair ended December 31, 2024; emeritus from January 1, 2025 is non-director honorary designation.
sources.caution: Non-employee advisory arrangement planned through end 2026 is terminable by board; do not assert guaranteed tenure.

sources.title: James Gorman adviser biography
sources.findings: Senior advisor; Melbourne BA and LLB; Columbia MBA.
sources.caution: Undated current biography; no appointment date inferred.

sources.title: February 3, 2026 CEO succession announcement
sources.findings: Board selected Josh D’Amaro following February 2 vote, with March 18 planned effective date. Gorman quoted as board chair and identified as succession committee chair since 2024.
sources.caution: Records announcement, not independent verification of March completion. Dated attributed statement supports life status.

sources.title: James P. Gorman biographical entry
sources.findings: Public preview states July 14, 1958 birth in Melbourne.
sources.caution: Only public preview read, not full paid entry. Its shorthand chair tenure 2012–2025 is replaced by primary-source executive/honorary distinction.

sources.title: E*TRADE acquisition closes
sources.findings: October 2, 2020 completed all-stock acquisition; digital direct-to-consumer channel added to wealth management.
sources.caution: Corporate acquisition, not personal purchase; historical financial totals omitted.
